channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Can Iran use rockets to mine the Strait of Hormuz, as US claims?
item.description: Analysts say it's implausible but Iran is well-versed in adapting conventional weapons to suit its needs.

item.title: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Turkiye meet: What’s next for their defence pact?
item.description: As US-Iran strikes resume, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye test their pact's substance, and who might join next.

item.title: More value in Cairo’s trash, but less for those who collect it
item.description: War on Iran disrupts imports, driving demand for Cairo’s recycled waste, but rising costs squeeze recyclers.

item.title: Who are the economic winners and losers of the US-Israel war on Iran?
item.description: Airlines and automakers have taken a hit, while banks and energy firms have raked in big profits.

item.title: UAE intercepts drone after US and Iran exchange attacks
item.description: The UAE says it intercepted a drone coming from Iran and rejected 'false' reports of an attack on its Al Menhad airbase.

item.title: The looming failure of Operation Economic Outcast
item.description: The latest package of US sanctions on Iran is unlikely to achieve Washington’s objectives.

item.title: Iran attacks Jordan, UAE after US bombs Larak Island: What’s the latest?
item.description: The retaliatory attacks came after the US targeted two Iranian launchers on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
item.description: The attack on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz - the first known US strike since late July - has killed two people and injured two others.

item.title: Man arrested after Swiss rave shooting that killed woman
item.description: A 22-year-old Italian woman was killed and several injured at a techno rave in Aarau.

item.title: British woman killed in stabbing at German railway station
item.description: A 27-year-old German man was arrested immediately after the incident in Rosenheim, Bavaria.
